description: Make a web page that a crew of simulated hands builds in front of its reader: column guides pulled down, frames dragged out with their size badges, text typed key by key, headlines pulled up to size, crayon drawn stroke by stroke, rows of labels typed at once and put right, then a flock that follows the reader's pointer. Built on this repository's engine in assembly/hand/. Use when a page or a section should assemble itself as it scrolls into view, when adding live "built by agents" or "cursors at work" motion to a page, when tuning how the pointers move or look, or when drawing crayon art for the hands to draw, even if the user never says "skill".
